exposure: Highly active antiretroviral therapy (HAART) introduction (before vs. after 1996)
Infants born to HIV-infected mothers before 1996
Infants born to HIV-infected mothers after 1996
cohort: 796 infants born to HIV-infected women in Israel between 1988 and 2011
finding: HAART during pregnancy and labor significantly reduced MTCT rates in infants born to HIV-infected mothers in Israel.
mod_finding: Mothers who transmitted HIV vertically were more likely to have delivered trans-vaginally.
